text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. In a code review, another developer carefully examines your code before it becomes part of the main project. This simple practice is incredibly valuable because it helps catch bugs early, before they reach users. When a fresh pair of eyes looks for logic errors or potential problems, it saves the team significant time and money later. Beyond fixing mistakes, code reviews are also a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn from senior ones, and everyone stays informed about different parts of the system. This shared understanding strengthens the whole team, ensuring that the quality of the final product is a true group effort.
